Alex K: Heads-up — RFC follow-up: we need an escape-hatch for kernel switchover per-model. Canary showed a perf regression when kernel-x was used. Thinking a per-model toggle to force fallback kernel path + telemetry. Anyone object?
Maya R: +1. We should make it sticky for in-flight requests and annotate telemetry with the override reason. Also need UI surface in Console.
Juan L: Agree. Also want to avoid thrashing between kernels — some hysteresis or decay window. Maybe a small priority queue to bias requests to fallback when a model is marked.
Sam T: Circuit-breaker + backoff seems reasonable. Implementation sketch: control-plane feature flag + runtime consult. Pseudocode: 
```
if model.feature_flags.fallback_kernel:
  selected = model.feature_flags.fallback_kernel
else:
  selected = kernel_selector.select(request)
```
Then record metric `runtime.kernel_override.count` and `runtime.fallback.latency`.
Priya S: Requirements: 1) rollout CLI to pin/unpin, 2) API endpoint for programmatic pinning (so integrations can opt-out), 3) audit log entry for overrides, 4) tests that simulate KV-cache warmup effects.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 271 on runtime-kernel-pop scheduled. Observed 500ms p50 spike on kernel-x when mem pressure high — https://ci/internal/123 (logs attached).
Alex K: Proposed plan: 1) add per-model flag in control plane (model -> fallback_kernel string) 2) runtime consults flag before kernel selection (fast path) 3) add decay-window (e.g., 10m) and a per-model circuit breaker 4) emit metrics + alert when reroute >5% for 15m.
Maya R: Edge case: mixed model versions. Order of precedence: version-specific override > model-level override > system default. DB change: extend `feature_flags` table with `scope_type`+`scope_id`. Prefer reusing existing feature flags service.
Juan L: I'll prototype runtime hook. Naming: `kernel_override` => stores kernel name or `null`. Metrics I'll emit: `runtime.kernel_override.count`, `runtime.fallback.latency.p50/p95`, `runtime.kernel_selection.throughput`.
Sam T: I'll add e2e perf matrix: warm KV, cold start, concurrent requests, and a small perf harness. Quick script snippet for perf runs: 
```bash
for t in 50 200 500; do ./perf_run.sh --concurrency $t --model foo --kernel kernel-x; done
```
Priya S: :thumbsup: Sync tomorrow 09:00PT to finalize schema and rollout checklist. Owners: Juan (runtime hook), Maya (control plane + Console), Sam (tests + perf harness), Alex (design + rollout).
Alex K: Created follow-up issue #4567 in tracker with action items and ETA 2 weeks. We'll use canary + gradual ramp with automatic rollback on SLA breach.
